I replied in your thread in #inc-vtg-hartford.

- **First report:** your 10:42 AM post on 3 Aug, that the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- **Guard in the meantime:** writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, per your 10:42 post. Once kiosk 1 was back, Mateo's 11:03 post says the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.
